meta.note: Friday morning briefing. Three top stories: the Section 301 178-item exclusion expires 11-09 with 3 days left and still no extension text; the rare-earth control suspension expires 11-10 with 4 days left and no renewal text, praseodymium-neodymium oxide rebounding to RMB 711,000/ton; the passive-component and CCL price-hike chain tightened further (Kingboard's 11-04 letter: FR-4 +10%, KEMET tantalum capacitors +20-30% from 11-01, Samsung Electro-Mechanics MLCC lead time 52 weeks). Industry updates: Vertiv x Infineon three-year Si/SiC agreement, Trane x LiquidStack 2.5MW CDU, LG AIDC orders over USD 2.11 billion, Midea liquid cooling into the NVIDIA supply chain, Haier completing the Ferroli Southeast Asia closing, Gree Q3 single-quarter net profit -43%. Siphon effects: the five big clouds' Q3 capex USD 237.3 billion, +95%; DDR5 spot USD 61.66, +484% YoY; Eaton data-center revenue +65%; CCL tightness extending into 2027/2028. Events library: 2 new events created (Vertiv-Infineon, Trane-LiquidStack CDU), 7 timeline entries added. Tier B batch 5: 1 hit in Memory, no anomalies in the other 10. English edition: generated by the 09:00 translation cron (main-model backfill; free link merge validation failed).

hotspot_events.title: Section 301 178-item exclusion expires 11-09 (3 days left), Federal Register still carries no extension text
hotspot_events.heat_reason: Tariff cost spike imminent; full Section 301 rates resume from 11-10 (25%/7.5%), with a clear action window (3 days or less)
hotspot_events.summary: The 178 Section 301 exclusion items expire 11-09 at 23:59 (ET); as of the morning of 11-06 the Federal Register still carries no extension text. Full Section 301 tariffs resume from 11-10 (25% for Lists 1/2/3, 7.5% for 4A). USTR has often announced only 0-3 days before expiry, sometimes publishing retroactively after expiry.

hotspot_events.title: Rare-earth export control suspension expires 11-10 (4 days left), no clear legal text on renewal
hotspot_events.heat_reason: NdFeB magnet steel supply chain under direct pressure; praseodymium-neodymium oxide has already rebounded; 4-day action window
hotspot_events.summary: The six-announcement suspension of 2025-10-09 runs to 11-10; on 9-28 the Ministry of Commerce said the China-US truce extends to 2027-01-10 but did not name rare earths or amend Announcement No. 70. Announcement No. 18 of 2025-04-04 (7 heavy rare earths) was never suspended and remains in force, with license review taking about 4 months. Praseodymium-neodymium oxide quoted at RMB 711,000/ton on 11-05 (+10,000).

hotspot_events.title: Passive-component and CCL price-hike chain tightens further: Kingboard 11-04 letter, tantalum capacitors +20-30% from 11-01, Samsung Electro-Mechanics MLCC lead time 52 weeks
hotspot_events.heat_reason: CCL + tantalum capacitors + MLCC: three price/lead-time lines tightening at once, hitting core PCBA makers; November is a clear action window
hotspot_events.summary: Kingboard Laminates' 11-04 letter: FR-4 CCL +10% across the board, PP prepreg thick cloth +10% / thin cloth +20%; electronic cloth 2116 thin cloth at RMB 20.2/m in November (+2.5 month-on-month). KEMET's second-round tantalum capacitor increase took effect 11-01 (+20%-30%). Samsung Electro-Mechanics MLCC lead time extended to 52 weeks (61 weeks at some distributors), Murata about 17 weeks, Yageo about 28 weeks.
numbers: Samsung Electro-Mechanics MLCC lead time 52 weeks

industry_updates.title: Vertiv and Infineon sign three-year strategic agreement
industry_updates.detail: Secures long-term supply of silicon (Si) and silicon carbide (SiC) power semiconductors, covering Vertiv's global power product portfolio (including next-generation 800V DC power systems); the two sides aligned technology roadmaps. Part of a multi-supplier strategy; no value or volumes disclosed.

industry_updates.title: Trane x LiquidStack jointly launch 2.5MW CDU; Nidec launches 3.2MW in-row CDU
industry_updates.detail: Trane and LiquidStack jointly launched a 2.5MW CDU, shipping from Q2 2027; Nidec launched a 3.2MW in-row CDU; Cooler Master also launched a 2.5MW in-row CDU on 10-26, targeting mass production in Q4.

industry_updates.title: LG Q3: AI data-center cooling cumulative orders exceed USD 2.11 billion
industry_updates.detail: Only about USD 422 million at the end of H1 - roughly 5x in one quarter; Q3 consolidated revenue USD 16.75 billion, operating profit USD 549.9 million.

industry_updates.title: Midea Building Technologies revenue RMB 30.9 billion; data-center liquid cooling enters NVIDIA supply chain
industry_updates.detail: Revenue for the first three quarters RMB 369.087 billion (+1.19%), net profit attributable to parent RMB 41.393 billion (+9.27%); Q3 single-quarter non-recurring net profit -22.49% (mainly about RMB 8.2 billion FX losses from RMB appreciation).

industry_updates.title: Haier completes 100% acquisition closing of Ferroli Southeast Asia
industry_updates.detail: Closing ceremony held in Vietnam on 11-03; the target is Ferroli's Southeast Asia unit (residential water heating and HVAC, top-three Vietnam electric water heater share), expanding smart HVAC in Southeast Asia and reaching Thailand and the Philippines; Q3 data-center sales were nearly 5x the same period last year.

industry_updates.title: Gree Q3 single-quarter net profit attributable to parent -43.31%
industry_updates.detail: Largest single-quarter decline in a Q3 report since listing; copper prices broke through RMB 99,000/ton in 2026, peaking above RMB 100,000/ton (+33% vs end-2025); copper is 20%-30% of unit cost, adding RMB 200-300 per unit; Gree holds prices and refuses aluminum-for-copper substitution.

industry_updates.title: Tariff policy sweep: Section 301 178-item exclusion expires 11-09 (3 days left)
industry_updates.detail: As of 11-06 the Federal Register still carries no extension text; from 11-10, Lists 1-3 resume at +25% and List 4A at +7.5%.

siphon_effects.detail: The five hyperscalers' combined Q3 capex was USD 237.3 billion (+95% YoY): Amazon USD 77.3 billion (+120%), Alphabet USD 51.4 billion (+114%), Microsoft USD 45.2 billion (+30%), Meta USD 34.9 billion (+80%), plus Oracle; combined 2026 guidance is about USD 725-745 billion, with demand still exceeding supply

DDR5 16Gb spot USD 61.66/chip (+8.13% in 30 days, +484% YoY), DDR4 8Gb USD 47.59/chip (+856% YoY); Q4 conventional DRAM contract prices expected +10-15% QoQ, NAND +15-20%; TeamGroup says the worst shortage runs from 2026Q4 to end-2027Q2, with supply and demand balancing only in H2 2028 at the earliest
NVIDIA cut HGX Rubin NVL8 specs: HBM4 from 2.3TB / 176TB/s to 2TB / 130TB/s (bandwidth -26%); Samsung HBM4 pricing is reportedly over 3x HBM3E per Gb (rumor-grade)

Eaton Q3 data-center revenue +65% (ninth consecutive quarter above +35%), electrical backlog +46%, electrical Americas backlog +33% to USD 16 billion, data-center project pipeline 366GW; Wood Mackenzie says the 2026 power-transformer gap is 15%, with average lead times of 2-3 years; ABB and Siemens Energy high-voltage lead times are 48-60 months, with new orders scheduled for delivery in 2030-2031

AI servers / data centers consume more high-layer-count, low-loss PCB material; tightness will last into 2027 or 2028; lead times are about 8-10 weeks for general material and 24-32 weeks for high-performance material; overall PCB costs up about 30-50%

cross_industry.detail: China's October NEV passenger wholesale was about 1.8 million units (+12% YoY, +8% MoM, a record); automotive SiC MOSFET lead times have stretched to 39-40 weeks (automakers shifting from IGBT to SiC); 800V platforms were 15% of NEV share in Q1 2026; shares power devices with HVAC

Huawei Digital Power wrote on 10-20 proposing +5%-15% (negotiated per customer, effective date TBD); Kehua Data raised all lines +5%-15% from 11-01, both citing copper, PCB and memory price increases; shares copper, CCL and memory with HVAC

Intel said on 10-29 that memory is one of the biggest challenges, expecting global PC shipments -12% in 2026 and -10% in 2027; TrendForce expects Korean fabs' PC-grade DRAM output to fall over 20% YoY next year; the DRAM squeeze has spread from AI servers to PCs

JPMorgan: data-center copper demand alone is expected at 475,000 tons in 2026 (110,000 tons in 2025); global copper demand is expected to rise from 28 million tons in 2025 to 42 million tons in 2040 (secondary-source figures)

supplier_updates.detail: Kingboard Laminates' 11-04 letter: all-thickness FR-4 CCL +10%, PP prepreg thick cloth +10% / thin cloth +20%; electronic cloth 2116 thin cloth at RMB 20.2/m in November (+2.5 MoM), 7628 thick cloth at RMB 14.6-14.65/m (+1.5 MoM); FR-4 CCL lead time stretched from days to about 4 weeks; TPCA expects tightness to continue into 2027 (channels disagree on the number of increases this year - not adopted)

KEMET's second-round tantalum capacitor increase took effect 11-01 (T520/T521/T530 series +20%-30%, extended from distributors to direct customers); Panasonic polymer tantalum capacitors +15%-30%, manganese-dioxide grade +10%-20%, with 70%-80% of 2027 capacity already locked and lead times stretched to 84 weeks; industrial aluminum electrolytic (400-450V) lead times stretched from 10-14 weeks in August to 18-22 weeks (channel-monitoring figures)

Samsung Electro-Mechanics MLCC lead time extended to 52 weeks (61 weeks listed at some distributors, vs 39-49 weeks in September); Murata about 17 weeks, Yageo about 28 weeks; Murata capacity utilization about 95%, with AI high-end MLCC inquiry orders about 2x capacity; Murata discontinued specific products in nine series including GRM/GRJ/GRT, last order 2028-03-31, final shipment 2029-03-31

No new letters in the window; a CITIC Securities 11-03 research note summarized 2026 increases across Infineon/TI/onsemi/ST (onsemi MOSFET/IGBT/SiC +5%-15% from 10-10, still flowing through); standard MOSFET lead time about 30 weeks, automotive IGBT/SiC many part numbers 40-50 weeks, SiC supply-chain inventory down from about 3 months to about 1 month (distributor/broker figures)

TI, ADI, onsemi, ST and Renesas have raised prices in succession since August; general server PMIC lead times stretched from 21-26 weeks to 35-40 weeks; some ADI precision amplifiers quoted at 60-70-week lead times (channel figures)

LME 3-month copper closed 11-05 at USD 14,005.5/ton (-0.04%), having briefly broken below USD 14,000 on 11-03 (intraday -2%+); total LME copper stocks 318,675 tons, of which US warehouses hold 223,300 tons - 70.1%, the highest share since March 2019 - against expectations that the US will levy a 15% tariff on refined copper imports from 2027; SHFE copper 11-05 at RMB 106,410/ton (+0.17%)
A00 aluminum national average RMB 23,380/ton (+30); China aluminum ingot spot inventory 467,000 tons (-34,000 tons vs prior period); SHFE aluminum 11-05 at RMB 23,180/ton (+0.80%)

R32/R134a/R125 market averages RMB 65,000/65,000/55,000 per ton, flat over the past month; R22 average RMB 18,000/ton (-5.26% weekly); US spot checked 23 listed prices in the week of 11-02 with no repricing; 2026 HFC production quota 797,800 tons in total

Praseodymium-neodymium oxide 11-05 average RMB 711,000/ton (+10,000); NdFeB blank N38H RMB 260/kg (steady); medium-yttrium europium-rich ore up RMB 1,000/ton to RMB 180,000-182,000/ton tax-included; control-suspension expiry risk - see top story
National rebar average RMB 3,226/ton on 11-04; weekly average RMB 3,237/ton (+14/ton week-on-week)
Centrifugal / reciprocating / rotary / scroll / screw - 5 categories: no price-increase letters or lead-time change notices in this round
Sanhua / DunAn / Yinlun: patent news only, no price-increase / EOL / lead-time news
